department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Final PhD deadline January 8, 2027; December 1, 2026 is the application-fee-waiver deadline (waivers for U.S.-school students and select international institutions).
deadline.quote: Fall 2027 Fee Waiver* Deadline December 1st, 2026 Fall 2027 PhD Application Deadline January 8th, 2027

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; scores may be submitted if you wish.

ielts_min.quote: IELTS: The minimum acceptable score is 7.0

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed before review, but applicants are encouraged to list and contact faculty of interest.
supervisor.quote: No. However, you are encouraged to list any faculty in which you may want to work with that are in line with your research interest and reach out to them.

funding.value: The PhD is fully funded through graduate assistantships with a living stipend, tuition waiver and health insurance.
funding.quote: Our doctorate program is fully funded through provided Graduate Assistantships and provide a living stipend.

entry_route.value: Apply directly with or without a master's; a bachelor's holder can earn the master's on the way.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who are interested in earning a Ph.D., whether or not they have a master’s degree, are encouraged to apply directly to the Ph.D. program.
